headline: School Board Meeting
summary: According to a letter by board member Jessica Seaton printed in the paper, the board voted 3-2 to extend the superintendent's contract, which ran to June 30, 2025, and to approve a $10,000 raise for the superintendent. The letter names Dr. Jim Perkins as making the motion, Lyndon Cain as seconding, Jeff Daniel as voting in favor, and Seaton and Stacy Stepp as voting against.

otherActions: Seaton's letter states the superintendent's contract had about a year and a half remaining, to June 30, 2025, and that a raise was not on the agenda.
Seaton's letter states Dr. Jim Perkins (District 3) and Jeff Daniel (District 4) are up for re-election in November 2024.
Invitation for depository bids (district funds, July 1, 2024 through June 30, 2027) issued by authority of the board dated Feb. 15, 2024, per the published legal notice.

quote.text: Despite my vocal opposition, the vote ultimately ended in a 3-2 split, with the extension of the contract and the $10,000 raise passing.
